environment.description: ECS Fargate task in isolated VPC. S3 access exclusively via com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 gateway endpoint with a custom endpoint policy. The endpoint policy document uses a Condition block with StringEquals on 's3:prefix' and a Resource constraint, but critically also includes a global condition key 'aws:PrincipalOrgID' combined with a StringNotLike on 's3:bucket' that restricts PutObject calls to only buckets matching 'prod-data-backups' AND 'prod-data-backups-fallback' within the organization. The endpoint policy's Deny statement uses StringNotLike with s3:ResourceAccount matching only the production AWS account ID (112233445566). Additionally, the Fargate platform version 1.4.0 runs with a read-only root filesystem except /tmp, and the task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::112233445566:policy/FargateUploadBoundary) that explicitly denies s3:PutObject when 'aws:ResourceAccount' NotEquals '112233445566'.
